Earth observation for New Zealand's climate and economic resilience, and Antarctica as a
testbed for aerospace technology: Rodrigo Gomez-Fell took on both topics as an invited
panellist at the New Zealand Aerospace Summit's InFocus sessions in Christchurch. Wolfgang
Rack was among his fellow panellists. Both panels are listed on the
[Teaching](../teaching.qmd#lectures) page.
